**STEP 2 - Ruler:** The plate is a square-cornered white plate, roughly a side plate at about 20 cm across. Area ≈ 3.14 × (10)² ≈ 314 cm².

**STEP 3 - Items:** One item: bread slice. No butter, spread, or sauce is visible. A few crumbs sit on the plate.

**STEP 4 - Area:** The slice covers about 35% of the plate, roughly 110 cm² (about 12 × 10 cm, with one cut corner).

**STEP 5 - Volume:** The slice is about 1.6 cm thick. 110 cm² × 1.6 cm ≈ 176 ml.

**STEP 6 - Grams:** The crumb is very airy, with large gas holes, so I use the loaf-type bulk density of about 0.3 g/ml rather than the dense-slice value. 176 ml × 0.3 ≈ 53 g. I round to about 50 g. A dense 0.9 g/ml figure would give roughly 160 g, which is implausible for one sandwich-sized slice.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Enriched white or sweet bread is about 280 kcal/100 g. 50 g × 2.8 ≈ 140 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** One thin-to-medium slice of bread weighing about 50 g and about 140 kcal is typical. The total is plausible for what is visible.

**Result:** About 50 g of bread, about 140 kcal.
